name: Unicorn Labyrinth Game
summary:
This app demonstrates the Unicorn Unity Bandpower Interface developed by g.tec medical engineering, showing how brain signals can be used to interact with digital environments in real time.

The application works exclusively with the Unicorn BCI Core-8 EEG headset or the Unicorn BCI Core-4 EEG headband. These are wearable brain-computer interface (BCI) devices that record electroencephalography (EEG) signals from the scalp, enabling users to control applications using their brain activity.
